lines.en: Wings spread, the cliff face slides away behind.

lines.zh: 贴着海面飞，浪花溅到鳞。
lines.en: Skimming the sea, spray hitting my scales.
I do not walk; I only glide.

lines.zh: 风从崖口来，正好托住我。
lines.en: Wind off the cliff mouth holds me up.
One flex of my body changes direction.

lines.zh: 飞过礁石，翅膀几乎擦到。
lines.en: Over the rocks, my wings almost graze them.
Diving low leaves my stomach weightless.

lines.zh: 沿海岸线绕一圈，找热气流。
lines.en: I circle the coastline hunting warm air.

lines.zh: 尾尖划过水面，留下一道线。
lines.en: My tail tip cuts the water, leaving a line.

lines.zh: 飞得低些，猎物才看得见。
lines.en: Lower now, so the prey can be seen.
Half-folding my wings to save some strength.
The nest birds on the cliff are calling again.

lines.zh: 上升时，鳞片被风吹得响。
lines.en: Climbing, the wind whistles over my scales.
A boat ahead; I give it a wide berth.

lines.zh: 我顺着崖壁的气流，贴着飞。
lines.en: I ride the updraft along the cliff and fly close to it.

lines.zh: 酸液在喉里晃，飞起来更沉。
lines.en: Acid sloshes in my throat, making flight heavier.
Coiled on the cliff stone, I sun my scales.
Tongue out, I taste salt and coming rain.

lines.zh: 下面有浪，一下一下地撞。
lines.en: Waves below, striking the rock in rhythm.
Wings spread, letting the wind pass through.
My venom sac is full; I need a target.

lines.zh: 海鸟叫得太吵，我闭上眼。
lines.en: The gulls are loud; I close my eyes.
Salt crusted between my scales, uncomfortable.
I have lived in this cliff crack a long time.

lines.zh: 蛇身绕两圈，头搁在上面。
lines.en: Two coils, and my head rests on top.
Something crawls below; too small to bother.
A wingtip flick scatters the insects.
I am waiting for the tide to rise.
The water below has the wrong color.
Coiled too long, my tail has gone stiff.
You stand at the edge; do you mean to jump?

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着弓，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a bow at your belt; I noticed.

lines.zh: 抬头，我在你左边的风里。
lines.en: Look up; I am in the wind to your left.

lines.zh: 别动，你的影子让我分心。
lines.en: Do not move; your shadow distracts me.

lines.zh: 你这身甲，酸液泡得动吗？
lines.en: Would that armor hold against my acid?

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕第三圈了。
lines.en: This is my third circle above your head.
That quiver makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 别站崖边，我俯冲不看路。
lines.en: Not near the cliff; I dive without looking.

lines.zh: 你想看飞蛇，就得往上看。
lines.en: To see a naga, you must look upward.

lines.zh: 我不吃人，但我讨厌被瞄。
lines.en: I do not eat people, but I hate being aimed at.

lines.zh: 翅膀撕开一道，扇不动了。
lines.en: A gash across my wing; it will not beat.
That arrow found the gap between scales.
A blow to my venom sac leaves it aching.

lines.zh: 我掉高度了，得赶紧拉起。
lines.en: Losing altitude; I must pull up fast.
Not the wings; they are all I have.

lines.zh: 血滴在石头上，声音很轻。
lines.en: Blood drips on the stone, very softly.
I hiss, and my voice comes out cracked.
Held too tight, I cannot pull free.
The pain makes my scales stand on end.
Back to the cliff edge; I still want to fly.
That fish: throw it over here.

lines.zh: 生肉的味道，隔着风也瞒不住。
lines.en: Raw meat cannot hide its smell from me.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，是给我看的？
lines.en: Holding the fish up high, is that for me?
I do not eat it cooked; do not roast it.
One seabird egg, cracked open, would do.
The smell of blood rides the wind this way.

lines.zh: 再往前递一点，我够不着。
lines.en: Bring it a little closer; I cannot reach.
When hungry, I fly low.
The fish is still flopping; perfect.
Feed me and I will not spit acid.
Hit me and you will simply slide off.

lines.zh: 翅膀被撞歪，我旋了半圈。
lines.en: A hit bends my wing; I spin half a turn.
You dare ram a flying serpent?
My scales are hard; your hand will hurt.
Step back; I land badly.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我从风里打偏。
lines.en: That knocked me out of my air current.
The ledge is narrow; do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 我盘起来，占的地方更小。
lines.en: I coil up to take less room.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到我毒牙了。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed against my fang.
One more shove and I stop being polite.
Two nagas circle above the cliff top.

lines.zh: 它的鳞是深青的，很好看。
lines.en: Its scales are deep blue-green, and lovely.
I spit a drop of acid; it catches it.

lines.zh: 并排滑翔，翅膀几乎碰到。
lines.en: Gliding abreast, our wings nearly touch.

lines.zh: 它在我的崖缝里落了脚。
lines.en: It has settled into my cliff crack.
Our calls answer, one high and one low.

lines.zh: 它替我守着巢，我出去找食。
lines.en: It guards the nest while I hunt.
Scale against scale, cool and smooth.

lines.zh: 这条海岸线，够我们两个飞。
lines.en: This coastline is wide enough for us both.
It flies ahead and I follow.
I snatch a fish and climb the cliff.
This bone will do for sharpening teeth.
I lift an egg without cracking the shell.

lines.zh: 海面上的东西，我顺手捞。
lines.en: Whatever floats by, I scoop it up.
This cloth will line the nest nicely.
Gripped in my teeth, then airborne.
I leave the shiny things; they are heavy.
What falls off the cliff belongs to me.
One circle first, to be sure no one steals.
Back to the nest; it is still empty.
That lamb stands too near the cliff edge.
It keeps staring at my nest.
The bow rises; I take to the air first.
This one walks with far too heavy a step.
Close enough now to begin the dive.
The sea wind pushes shoreward; just right.

lines.zh: 它转头看海，那一瞬最好。
lines.en: It turns to the sea; that instant is best.
Aim for the throat; that is the softest part.
Wings pulled low, ready to accelerate.
It moves, and so do I.
Circling, waiting for it to look up.

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我就低一尺。
lines.en: Each step it retreats, I drop a foot.
My venom sac tightens; not yet.
It raises the bow; I slide sideways at once.
My shadow sweeps the ground; it searches.
I wait for the draw; that moment is slowest.
I move around to the sun's side.

lines.zh: 翅膀别扇太响，会露位置。
lines.en: Beat my wings softly or give my position away.
Two yards short; a little closer.

lines.zh: 它喘气了，机会就在眼前。
lines.en: It is panting; the opening is right there.
Diving down, my fangs arrive first.
A tail whip cracks across its ankles.
A splash of acid lands before its feet.
I bite the shoulder plate and drag upward.
My wings throw a faceful of grit at it.
I wrap around, squeeze, then release.
It stops my fangs but not my acid.

lines.zh: 从背后掠过去，只碰一下。
lines.en: I sweep past from behind, just a graze.

lines.zh: 毒牙划破皮，就够它受的。
lines.en: One scratch from my fang is enough.
Strike, then climb; leave no opening.
In the cliff crack, an eggshell splits.

lines.zh: 第一眼是海，第二眼是风。
lines.en: First I see the sea, then the wind.
My wings are still wet; I must dry them.
The wind up here is far bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 下面全是浪，没有落脚处。
lines.en: Waves everywhere below, nowhere to land.
I coil into a tight knot by the nest.

lines.zh: 父母在头顶盘旋，叫我上去。
lines.en: My parents circle overhead, calling me up.
My scales have hardened but are still pale.

lines.zh: 海盐的味道，我一出生就认得。
lines.en: I knew the taste of sea salt from birth.

lines.zh: 试着扇一下翅膀，起来了。
lines.en: One trial beat of my wings, and I rise.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到翅膀，焦了一片。
lines.en: Flame licks my wing and singes a patch.
My wing folds wrong; I can only drop.

lines.zh: 落进海里，翅膀拖着我沉。
lines.en: Down in the sea, my wings drag me under.
The blast rolls me over in midair.

lines.zh: 箭穿进翅根，我直往下掉。
lines.en: An arrow in my wing root, and I fall.

lines.zh: 有什么缠住我的鳞，甩不掉。
lines.en: Something binds my scales and will not shake off.
Hungry enough that my venom sac runs dry.

lines.zh: 雷在崖顶炸开，我鳞片发麻。
lines.en: Thunder cracks on the cliff; my scales tingle.
Falling, until even the sea sound is gone.
